On the right, a large close-up of them smiling warmly, wearing an open-collar [SHIRT_COLOR: olive green] linen shirt with layered gold necklaces. prompts.title: Golden-Hour Meadow Portrait Grid
prompts.prompt: Create a 2x2 grid of four photos of the person in the photo in a sunlit wildflower meadow at golden hour, in a soft dreamy editorial style. Panel 1: standing, one hand raised near the face, soft smile. Panel 2: walking toward the camera through tall grass. Panel 3: looking back over the shoulder. Panel 4: seated on a large flat rock with a warm smile. In every panel they wear a rust-brown off-shoulder top and high-waisted light-wash jeans. Tall green grass, scattered orange wildflowers, soft blurred trees, a warm golden haze, gentle rim light on the hair, and a [COLOR_PALETTE: warm golden-orange and green] color grade. Same face, hair, skin tone and body in all four panels, exactly as in the photo.

prompts.title: Fragmented Luxury Fashion Portrait
prompts.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic, premium cinematic editorial portrait of the person in the photo, inspired by a high-end luxury fashion campaign. The subject is positioned in the center of the composition, shown from approximately the waist up, standing confidently with their upper body slightly turned to one side while their face is angled slightly downward and toward the side. Their expression is calm, sophisticated, confident, and thoughtful, with a subtle natural smile. Their arms are crossed naturally in front of the body, with one forearm resting horizontally across the lower torso. Dress the subject in an elegant [OUTFIT_COLOR: dark navy-blue] traditional formal outfit with a high collar and refined tailoring, a premium metallic wristwatch with a detailed dark dial, and sophisticated dark-framed sunglasses. Transform the portrait into a sophisticated three-dimensional fragmented gallery composition. Instead of showing the person as one continuous flat photograph, divide the image into multiple tall, narrow vertical and diagonal rectangular panels. The central panels should contain the main portrait of the subject, while surrounding panels extend outward at different depths and angles, creating the illusion that the photograph has been physically separated into floating architectural panels. Each panel must look like a thin, rigid photographic slab with realistic thickness, sharp edges, and subtle shadows. Keep the person's face and identity unchanged, preserving their exact facial proportions, skin tone, jawline, eyes, nose, lips, realistic skin texture, and authentic human anatomy exactly as shown in the photo

prompts.title: Golden Hour Motion Blur Portrait
prompts.prompt: A hyper-realistic cinematic photograph of the person in the photo, captured in strong, striking movement with intense motion blur. Strong warm golden backlight creates a luminous halo around their hair and shoulders, with dense dark green trees in the background. Only the face remains a sharp focal anchor point, while the body, arms, and fabric are heavily blurred from the motion. Hair is caught dramatically in the wind, catching the backlight and glowing. prompts.title: Office Paper Explosion Portrait
prompts.prompt: A dynamic, frozen-in-time scene where the person in the photo is standing in the center of an office explosion of paperwork. Thousands of white sheets of paper are suspended in mid-air around the subject in a spiral pattern. The subject is wearing a sleek black turtleneck and glasses, standing perfectly still and calm amidst the chaos, looking at the camera.
